# Wiki Comercio Exterior MX
Public wiki and official-URL catalog for Mexican foreign trade.
Wiki: docs/wiki/ (fundamentos, aduana, clasificacion, contribuciones, programas, logistica)
Catalog: docs/catalog/
Corpus: data/corpus/
Tariff tables: https://github.com/jccontrerasg08-cpu/arancel-mx
Incoterms: ICC catalog URLs only (https://iccwbo.org/business-solutions/incoterms-rules/)
Mexico TIGIE-SCIAN: https://www.inegi.org.mx/app/tigie/ (catalog; scrape)
